zh: 配对只看大小关系，与原来的位置无关，可以先把两个数组排序；如果某个 a 连最小的未配对 b 都赢不了，它就赢不了任何 b。
贪心：用当前最小的可用 a 去匹配最小的未配对 b，能严格大于就配成一对，否则直接舍弃这个 a。
两数组都升序排序，用指针 j 指向 b 中第一个未配对的元素；按顺序遍历 a，若当前 a 严格大于 b[j] 则 j 加 1；遍历结束时 j 就是最大配对数。
en: Pairing depends only on values, not on positions, so both arrays can be sorted first; an a that cannot beat the smallest unmatched b cannot beat any b.
Greedy: match the smallest available a against the smallest unmatched b; if it is strictly greater, pair them, otherwise discard that a.

Sort both arrays ascending and keep a pointer j to the first unmatched b; walk through a in order and advance j whenever the current a is strictly greater than b[j]; at the end j is the maximum number of pairs.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort both arrays in ascending order and match the smallest available a against the smallest available b; if a is not large enough, skip that a.

## Proof of correctness

If the smallest a cannot beat the smallest b, it cannot beat any remaining b and can be discarded. If it can, some optimal solution contains this pair: if each was originally paired with another element, after swapping, the other, larger a can still beat the b that was originally matched with the current a; in the remaining cases a direct replacement does not reduce the count. By induction the greedy is optimal.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
